name: @r1ck404/fast-acorn

author: R1ck404 (https://github.com/R1ck404)

scripts.test: node test/comments.mjs && node test/options.mjs && node test/diff.mjs --limit 800
scripts.test:full: node --stack-size=4000 test/diff.mjs --locs --comments --nodepod && node test/expr-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/jsx-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/override-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/error-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/acorn-diff.mjs
